claude_proposed_widenings.name: SpeciesTraitRecord
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: UnitRecord has no species_trait kind. The surface schema (types.ts) defines SpellRecord | ClassFeatureRecord | MasteryRecord only. species_trait_root exists in the v4 taxonomy atom inventory but has no corresponding authored record type.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Naturally Stealthy is tagged kind: species_trait in the survey manifest but UnitRecord cannot represent it.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: expand_action_eligibility
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The mechanic is a permanent passive modification of the precondition for taking an action (Hide). It neither activates nor consumes resources — it widens the set of circumstances under which the action is legally available. No v4 effect atom covers this shape. The closest candidates (grant_extra_action, restrict_action_set) are activation-scoped or restriction-scoped; neither models 'action X is permitted even when condition Y'.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You can take the Hide action even when you are obscured only by a creature that is at least one size larger than you.

discrepancies: no content/species_halfling_naturally_stealthy.json authored; accepted self-report-only widening path
